Waldbühne 1997 - St. Petersburg White Night
programme.desc: The 1997 edition of the Waldbühne concert is dedicated to Russian composers. The Berliner Philharmoniker, directed by Zubin Mehta, kicks off the evening with the opening of Mikhail Glinka's opera Ruslan and Ludmila. The 1997 edition of the Waldbühne concert is dedicated to Russian composers. The Berliner Philharmoniker, directed by Zubin Mehta, kicks off the evening with the opening of Mikhail Glinka's opera Ruslan and Ludmila, after which Daniel Barenboim takes center stage to perform Tchaikovsky's Piano Concerto No. 1 and Chopin's Waltz in D flat major, op. 64 No. 1. The evening then pays homage to Mussorgsky with the prelude Khovanshchina and Gopak, taken from The Fair at Sorotchinsky. The orchestra also interprets Flight of the Bumblebee and Capriccio Espagnol, op. 34 from Rimsky-Korsakov. As is tradition, the Berliner Philharmoniker closes this Waldbühne concert with Paul Lincke's Berliner Luft.

programme.title: Documentary 2017
programme.desc: This short documentary follows the participants of the 11th International Franz Liszt Piano Competition, held in TivoliVredenburg, Utrecht 2017. The competition actively presents, develops and promotes piano talents from around the world. This short documentary follows the participants of the 11th International Franz Liszt Piano Competition, held in TivoliVredenburg, Utrecht, in 2017. The competition actively presents, develops, and promotes piano talents from around the world. In doing so, it has become one of the prominent gateways to the international professional classical music scene for young musicians. The International Franz Liszt Piano Competition was founded in 1986 in the Netherlands and has since built a reputation as one of the world’s most prestigious piano competitions.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 5, Op. 64
programme.desc: In May 2019, the new principal conductor of the Gewandhaus, Andris Nelsons, presented Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 5 with his orchestra in combination with Shostakovich’s Violin Concerto No. 1 with outstanding violinist Baiba Skride as the soloist. In May 2019, the new principal conductor of the Gewandhaus, Andris Nelsons, presented Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 5 with his orchestra in combination with Shostakovich’s Violin Concerto No. 1 with outstanding violinist Baiba Skride as the soloist. In this composition, the violin does not allow itself a break, continually tells its dark story and gets into a vicious circle of ostinato Passacaglia bass lines again and again falls into beguilingly beautiful singing. Tchaikovsky initially thought his 'Symphony of Fate' was a failure and believed himself to be at the end of his creative powers. It was probably the composer's nature, plagued by self-doubt, that made it almost impossible for him to develop a self-confident attitude to his own creative power. Between this two works, Skride performs Stravinsky's Elegy for Solo Violin.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Ives, Brahms a. o.
programme.desc: Bass-baritone Matthias Hoffmann (Austria, 1991) and pianist Lisa Ochsendorf (Germany, 1991) perform works by Charles Ives, Hans Erich Pfitzner, Hans Sommer, Johannes Brahms, Henri Duparc, Bart Visman, Francis Poulenc, Franz Schubert, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Moritz Eggert, during the semi-finals of the International Vocal Competition 2021 - Lied Duo. This performance was recorded at Het Noordbrabants Museum in ’s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands. Bass-baritone Matthias Hoffmann (Austria, 1991) and pianist Lisa Ochsendorf (Germany, 1991) perform ‘A. Very pleasant’ from Charles Ives’s song ‘Memories’; ‘Nachtwanderer’ from Hans Erich Pfitzner’s Fünf Lieder, Op. 7; ‘Nachts’ from Hans Sommer’s Zehn Lieder, Op. 9; ‘Da unten im Tale’ from Johannes Brahms’s Deutsche Volkslieder, WoO. 33; Henri Duparc’s Chanson triste; Bart Visman’s Vermeer's gold; ‘La maîtresse volage’ from Francis Poulenc’s Chansons gaillardes, FP 42; Franz Schubert’s Gruppe aus dem Tartarus, Op. 24, No. 1, D. 583; ‘Na smert’ chizhika’ (On the death of a linnet) from Sergei Rachmaninoff’s Twelve Romances, Op. 21; and ‘Sprich, Scheherazade’ from Moritz Eggert’s Neue Dichter Lieben, during the semi-finals of the International Vocal Competition 2021 - Lied Duo. This performance was recorded at Het Noordbrabants Museum in ’s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands.

programme.title: Rachmaninov - Suite No. 1, Op. 5 - II. The Night …
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021. In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. They perform regularly in a duo. On the program: Mozart’s Sonata for two pianos in D major, K. 448/375 A; Ravel’s La Valse (arr. for two pianos); Arensky’s Suite No. 1 for two pianos, Op. 15; and Rachmaninoff’s Suite No. 1 (Fantasy) for two pianos, Op. 5. As an encore, the duo performs ‘Romance’ from Rachmaninoff’s Suite No. 2 for two pianos, Op. 17, followed by ‘Overture’ from Nikolai Kapustin’s Sinfonietta, Op. 49. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Carter Johnson
programme.desc: Pianist Carter Johnson (Canada, 1996) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Sostenuto assai - Allegro ma non troppo, of Robert Schumann’s Piano Quartet in E-flat major, Op. 47. This performance took place during the chamber music round of the two-part semi-final of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM). It was recorded at the Bourgie Hall of the Montreal Museum of Fine Arts.

programme.title: Sergiu Celibidache - The Triumphant Return
programme.desc: Wolfgang Becker's documentary The Triumphant Return documents Celibidache's long-awaited return to the Berlin Philharmonic after a 38-year-absence. Discover extensive footage from the rehearsals of Anton Bruckner's Symphony No. 7. Maestro Sergiu Celibidache conducted the Berliner Philharmoniker from 1945 to 1954, and once in 1992. Wolfgang Becker's documentary The Triumphant Return documents Celibidache's long-awaited return to the Berlin Philharmonic after a 38-year-absence. Discover extensive footage from the rehearsals of Anton Bruckner's Symphony No. 7 (the only video recording in existence of Celibiadache), interviews with former orchestra members, and Celibidache's final concert with the Berliner Philharmoniker.

programme.title: Ravel - Piano Concerto in G major
programme.desc: Mikhail Pletnev leads the Russian National Orchestra (RNO) in a performance of Maurice Ravel's First Piano Concerto with Lucas Debargue as the soloist. It was recorded at Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow as part of the Ninth RNO Grand Festival. Mikhail Pletnev leads the Russian National Orchestra in a performance of Maurice Ravel's Piano Concerto in G major, featuring Lucas Debargue as the soloist. The composer completed this lively three-movement Piano Concerto in 1931. He incorporated several jazz elements in the work, especially in the two outer movements. This performance was recorded at Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, in 2017, as part of the Ninth RNO Grand Festival.

programme.title: Baroque choral music by Bach, Schütz et al.
programme.desc: Five-strong vocal ensemble amarcord is joined by an extra alto and two soprano voices for this unusual concert at Leipzig’s St. Thomas Church. As amarcordplus, the ensemble presents a program focused on the city of Leipzig, which includes works by Johann Hermann Schein, Heinrich Schütz, Johann Sebastian Bach, Philipp Heinrich Erlebach, mononymous composer Liebhold, Johann Michael Bach, and Johann Christoph Bach. This performance was recorded on May 1, 2020. Five-strong vocal ensemble amarcord is joined by an extra alto and two soprano voices for this unusual concert at Leipzig’s St. Thomas Church. As amarcordplus, the ensemble presents a program focused on the city of Leipzig, which includes sacred madrigals by Johann Hermann Schein, motets from Heinrich Schütz’s collection Geistliche Chor-Music, as well as two motets by the most famous Thomaskantor: Johann Sebastian Bach. Moreover, various sacred works by lesser-known contemporaries Philipp Heinrich Erlebach and mononymous composer Liebhold are performed, in addition to compositions by other members of the Bach family, including Johann Michael Bach and Johann Christoph Bach. This performance was recorded on May 1, 2020.

As amarcordplus, the ensemble presents a program focused on the city of Leipzig, which includes works by Johann Hermann Schein, Heinrich Schütz, Johann Sebastian Bach, Philipp Heinrich Erlebach, mononymous composer Liebhold, Johann Michael Bach, and Johann Christoph Bach. This performance was recorded on May 1, 2020. Five-strong vocal ensemble amarcord is joined by an extra alto and two soprano voices for this unusual concert at Leipzig’s St. Thomas Church. As amarcordplus, the ensemble presents a program focused on the city of Leipzig, which includes sacred madrigals by Johann Hermann Schein, motets from Heinrich Schütz’s collection Geistliche Chor-Music, as well as two motets by the most famous Thomaskantor: Johann Sebastian Bach. Moreover, various sacred works by lesser-known contemporaries Philipp Heinrich Erlebach and mononymous composer Liebhold are performed, in addition to compositions by other members of the Bach family, including Johann Michael Bach and Johann Christoph Bach. This performance was recorded on May 1, 2020.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Finzi, Duparc a. o.
programme.desc: Tenor Ilja Aksionov (Lithuania, 1996) and pianist Gustas Raudonius (Lithuania, 1996) perform works by Bart Visman, Gerald Finzi, Henri Duparc, Claude Debussy, Hugo Wolf, Sergei Rachmaninoff, Franz Schubert, and Alphons Diepenbrock, during the semi-finals of the International Vocal Competition 2021 - Lied Duo. This performance was recorded at Het Noordbrabants Museum in ’s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands. Tenor Ilja Aksionov (Lithuania, 1996) and pianist Gustas Raudonius (Lithuania, 1996) perform Bart Visman’s Het goud van Vermeer; ‘As I lay in the early sun’ from Gerald Finzi’s Oh fair to see, Op. 13b; Henri Duparc’s Extase; Claude Debussy’s Paysage sentimental, L. 55; ‘Mausfallensprüchlein’ from Hugo Wolf’s Sechs Lieder; ‘Krysolov’ (The pied piper) from Sergei Rachmaninoff’s Six Romances, Op. 38; Franz Schubert’s Rastlose Liebe, Op. 5, No. 1, D. 138; and Alphons Diepenbrock’s De klare dag, RC 4, during the semi-finals of the International Vocal Competition 2021 - Lied Duo. This performance was recorded at Het Noordbrabants Museum in ’s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces - Brandenburg Concertos
programme.desc: This episode of Discovering Masterpieces presents the Brandenburg Concertos by Johann Sebastian Bach (1685-1750). Musical excerpts played by the Freiburger Barockorchester conducted by Gottfried von der Goltz. This episode presents the Brandenburg Concertos by Johann Sebastian Bach (1685-1750). Musical excerpts played by the Freiburger Barockorchester conducted by Gottfried von der Goltz. Bach's six Brandenburg Concertos rank among the undisputed favorites of all baroque fans. They have become a firm fixture in music education and an integral part of our international musical heritage. So what's their secret? The internationally acclaimed pianist and Bach expert Robert Levin provides an answer.

programme.title: Naples, city of keyboards - Giovanni de Macque
programme.desc: The harmonic experiments, radical chromaticism and stylistic freedom of Giovanni De Macques prove how exciting Neapolitan keyboard repertoire actually is. Baroque expert Jean-Marc Aymes chooses his favourite toccatas and canzonas from the keyboard oeuvre of this Franco-Flemish composer, whose employers included the Gesualdo family in Naples. programme.title: Approaching the Maelström
programme.desc: The 2019 documentary ‘Approaching the Maelström’ follows the process leading up to a recording of American composer Philip Glass’s composition ‘A Descent into the Maelström’. The work is based on American writer Edgar Allan Poe’s 1841 short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, Norway. Glass’s work, originally a choral piece for the Australian Dance Theatre, was only ever performed at the Adelaide Festival of Arts in 1986. The 2019 documentary ‘Approaching the Maelström’ follows the process leading up to a recording of American composer Philip Glass’s composition ‘A Descent into the Maelström’. The work is based on American writer Edgar Allan Poe’s 1841 short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, Norway. Glass’s work, originally a choral piece for the Australian Dance Theatre, was only ever performed at the Adelaide Festival of Arts in 1986. Over thirty years later, in 2019, Beacon Isle Films recorded a symphonic arrangement of Glass’s work, performed by the Arctic Philharmonic Orchestra and Choir conducted by Tim Weiss with soprano Berit Norbakken Solset as the soloist. Their recording was made against the backdrop of Lofoten’s spectacular landscape: the very surroundings that inspired Poe’s story. Moreover, this inspiring documentary features a rare interview with Glass.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: Together with the world's leading youth orchestra - the Gustav Mahler Jugendorchester (GMJO) - Abbado performs Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 4 and Arnold Schönberg’s Pelleas et Melisande, Op.5. Recorded 2006 at Musikverein Vienna. The program is introduced with a short documentation about Schönberg's Pelleas et Melisande, based on a text by Claudio Abbado. Every musical theme relates to a special colour appearing on screen. What has been so remarkable about Abbado’s Mahler performances is that their impact has never been achieved at the expense of the multiple sensitivities, subtleties and extreme sophistication. Together with the world's leading youth orchestra - the Gustav Mahler Jugendorchester (GMJO) - Abbado performs Mahler’s Symphony No. 4 and Schönberg’s Pelleas und Melisande, Op. 5. The Gustav Mahler Jugendorchester was founded in Vienna in 1986, by Abbado’s initiative. The orchestra's high level of artistic quality and its international success have moved important conductors and soloists to work with the ensemble.

programme.title: PIAM - Final: Beethoven, Chopin and Prokofiev
programme.desc: The first edition of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM) was dedicated to the piano. During the competition’s final round, Ying Li (China, 1997) performs Ludwig van Beethoven’s Sonata No. 28 in A major, Op. 101; Frédéric Chopin’s Fantasia in F minor, Op. 49; and Sergei Prokofiev’s Sonata No. 7 in B-flat major, Op. 83. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatory of Milan, in July 2021. Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano. During the competition’s final round, Ying Li (China, 1997) performs Ludwig van Beethoven’s Sonata No. 28 in A major, Op. 101; Frédéric Chopin’s Fantasia in F minor, Op. 49; and Sergei Prokofiev’s Sonata No. 7 in B-flat major, Op. 83. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatory of Milan, in July 2021.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Brahms, Britten a. o.

programme.title: Wagner - Die Walküre
programme.desc: Die Walküre continues the story of the Rhinedaughters' gold, the ring of power which was forged from it, and the curse which falls on its owner. Die Walküre is the second opera in Richard Wagner's Ring Cycle. This rendition (2003) features the Staatsoper Stuttgart under the baton of conductor Lothar Zagrosek. Tonight’s soloists are Robert Gambill, Attila Jun, Jan-Hendrik Rootering, Angela Denoke, Renate Behle, Tchina Vaughn, Eva-Maria Westbroek and Wiebke Göetjes. Die Walküre continues the story of the Rhinedaughters' gold, the ring of power forged from it, and the curse which falls on its owner. The action moves to earth - where Siegmund and Sieglinde, the mortal children of Wotan, are introduced - and follows the downfall of Wotan's hopes that Siegmund will prove to be the hero who saves the gods. Brünnhilde, the Valkyrie (warrior maiden) who gives the opera its title, becomes inextricably bound up with Wotan's pursuit of his vision.

programme.title: Monteverdi - Madrigals, Book III
programme.desc: In 2011, British tenor Paul Agnew and renowned Baroque ensemble Les Arts Florissants started recording eight books of Claudio Monteverdi’s madrigals. In this program, Agnew leads Les Arts Florissants in the madrigals of Book III. Published in 1592, the book contains twenty madrigals for five voices. This performance was recorded at the Cité de la musique in Paris, France, in 2012. Italian composer Claudio Monteverdi (1567-1643) composed nine books of madrigals in half a century, which helped transform the genre from the polyphonic, a cappella madrigals of the late Renaissance to the ‘concertato’ madrigals of the early Baroque, shifting the style’s focus to the ability of music to express emotions contained in a text. In 2011, British tenor Paul Agnew and renowned Baroque ensemble Les Arts Florissants started recording eight books of Monteverdi’s madrigals. In this program, Agnew leads Les Arts Florissants in the madrigals of Book III. Published in 1592, the book contains twenty madrigals for five voices. This performance was recorded at the Cité de la musique in Paris, France, in 2012.

programme.title: Ravel - Boléro
programme.desc: French conductor Adrien Perruchon and the Flanders Symphony Orchestra take us on a musical journey to Argentine, Spain, and Mexico, in this March 1, 2017 concert performance at Concertgebouw Brugge in Belgium. The program includes Édouard Lalo’s Spanish Symphony for violin and orchestra, Op. 21, featuring Czech violinist Josef Špaček as the soloist; Mathias Coppens’ Music for Orchestra, Op. 12; Alberto Ginastera’s Dances from Estancia, Op. 8a; Aaron Copland’s El Salón México; Maurice Ravel’s famous Boléro; and Arturo Márquez’s Danzón No. 2.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances present Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, ‘Eroica’. This performance was recorded at Opéra de Dijon, France, in 2012. Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances present Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, ‘Eroica’. Admiring the ideals of the French Revolution, Beethoven initially dedicated the symphony to Napoleon Bonaparte. However, upon hearing that Napoleon had crowned himself Emperor, Beethoven violently erased Napoleon’s name from the manuscript. Composed in 1803-04 in a style that breaks with tradition, the symphony is regarded as a turning point in Beethoven’s oeuvre as well as Western music history. Symphony No. 3 is longer in duration than any previous symphony. The work opens with two powerful chords that replace the more customary long introduction. The lower strings then introduce the main theme. The slow second movement is a Funeral March, followed by a quick Scherzo. The fourth and final movement is dominated by a theme from Beethoven’s ballet music for ‘The Creatures of Prometheus’. This performance was recorded at Opéra de Dijon, France, in 2012.

programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Jakub Kuszlik
programme.desc: Pianist Jakub Kuszlik (Poland, 1996) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Sostenuto assai - Allegro ma non troppo, of Robert Schumann’s Piano Quartet in E-flat major, Op. 47. This performance took place during the chamber music round of the two-part semi-final of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM). It was recorded at the Bourgie Hall of the Montreal Museum of Fine Arts.

programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Bruckner's Symnphony No. 7. The work occupies a singularly important place in the composer's output. It was with this piece that Bruckner finally achieved widespread recognition and it has remained one of his most popular works. Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Bruckner's Symphony No. 7. The work occupies a singularly important place in the composer's output. It was with this piece that Bruckner finally achieved widespread recognition and it has remained one of his most popular works. The symphony adheres to the classical four-movement format. The heart of the work is a long and deeply felt Adagio, composed as a memorial to Wagner. The first movement begins with a soaring theme announced by cellos. The Scherzo relieves the somber atmosphere of the preceding Adagio and the Finale concludes the symphony on a note of unrestrained joy. Recorded in Severance Hall, Cleveland in 2008.

programme.title: Gala from Berlin - 2010
programme.desc: During the New Year’s Gala 2010, the Berlin Philharmonic perform under the baton of Gustavo Dudamel. They welcome mezzo-soprano Elīna Garanča, who has become one of the world’s most famous singers within just a few years. During the New Year’s Gala 2010, the Berlin Philharmonic perform under the baton of Gustavo Dudamel, whose infectious energy and exceptional artistry have made him one of the most sought-after conductors by orchestras and opera companies around the world. They welcome mezzo-soprano Elīna Garanča, who has become one of the world’s most famous singers within just a few years. On the program are various works by French composers, like Berlioz’ Le Carnival Romain, Overture, Op. 9 and D’Amour l’ardente flamme’ from La Damnation de Faust (Op. 24), Saint-Saëns’ ‘Mon cœur s’ouvre à ta voix’ and ‘Danse Bacchanale’ from his opera Samson et Dalila and the ‘Habanera’, ‘Seguidilla’ and ‘Chanson Bohème’ from Bizet’s Carmen. The concert concludes with de Falla’s Suite No. 2 from the ballet ‘El sombrero de tres picos’.

programme.title: Bach - The Well-Tempered Clavier No. 24
programme.desc: The Well-Tempered Clavier, BWV 846-893, is a collection of two series of Preludes and Fugues in all 24 major and minor keys, composed for solo keyboard by Bach. In this broadcast, Joanna MacGregor plays Preludes and Fugues No. 13 to 24 (BWV 858-869). In 1722, when Johann Sebastian Bach lived in Köthen, Germany, he published a book of preludes and fugues in all 24 major and minor keys. This collection became known as The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book One, BWV 846-869. About two decades later, Bach compiled a second book in Leipzig, which became known as The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book Two, BWV 870-893. Bach intended these pieces for the clavier, which includes the harpsichord, clavichord, and organ. Despite this unclarity, these pieces are regarded as some of the most important works in the history of Western classical music. In this broadcast, Joanna MacGregor plays Preludes and Fugues Nos. 13 to 24 (BWV 858-869) from Book One of Bach’s Well-Tempered Clavier, recorded at the Palau Güell in Barcelona, Spain, in 2010.

programme.title: Handel - Agrippina
programme.desc: Agrippina is a fresh, exuberantly inventive opera and sets one of the finest librettos Handel has worked with. It was duly recorded under the baton of Arnold Östman, a renowned specialist in music of the 17th and 18th centuries. Schwetzingen, a small German town near Heidelberg, boasts a famous palace with gardens as magnificent as those at Versailles. In the spring, the palace is the backdrop for the Schwetzingen Festival. Every year, the festival commissions a small-scale opera for the palace's exquisite Rococo theatre, built in 1752. Agrippina is a brilliant early George Frideric Handel opera. Composed when he was just twenty-four, it was Handel's first big hit in the theater. It’s full of his fresh, exuberantly inventive music, and set to a libretto by Cardinal Vincenzo Grimani, one of the finest librettists Handel ever worked with. This staging of Agrippina was recorded under the baton of Arnold Östman, a renowned specialist in the music of the 17th and 18th centuries. The London Baroque Players accompany Barbara Daniels, Janice Hall, and David Kuebler in Michael Hampe's elegant and colourful production that shows us the perfidious intrigues of the power-crazy Empress Agrippina, and the criminal power struggles in classical Rome.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Zexal
programme.desc: Kada ambiciozni duelist Yuma upozna Astral, tajanstvenog posjetitelja iz drugog svemira, čini se kao sudbina. Yuma treba Astrala da ga nauči kako da se dvoboji, a Astral treba Yumu da mu pomogne povratiti sjećanja! Oni bi bili najveći tag tim dvoboja... osim što se ne slažu! Ovaj duel bolje da se brzo spoji jer ZEXAL je potpuno novi dvoboj s većim izazovima nego ikad prije! Fantastična nova čudovišta! Snažne nove karte! Tehnologija dvoboja s proširenom stvarnošću! Zajedno, dvoboj ide na sljedeću razinu! Ali ne brinite ako nikada prije niste bili u dvoboju: Dok Astral prolazi Yumom kroz osnove, novi gledatelji mogu pratiti i naučiti kako se natjecati. A za iskusne profesionalce, postoji mnogo nikad viđenih strategija koje se mogu koristiti u stvarnom životu! Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL - Nova pravila, novi dvoboji!

Epizode uključuju avanture obitelji koja se upušta u neobične i često duhovite situacije, kao što je izgradnja rakete za Mars ili djeca koja pokušavaju od roditelja sakriti slona kojeg su pronašli u divljini, a iz svega toga likovi dobivaju novu, životnu pouku.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Dobrodošli u CoComelon svijet! CoComelon je glazbena animirana serija koja prati malog JJ-a i njegovu obitelj u svakodnevim situacijama s kojima se mogu poistovjetiti svi predškolci. Svaki dan uče nešto novo - slova, brojeve, boje, životinje i još mnogo toga. A sve to kroz igru i pjesmice koje lako ulaze u uho!

programme.title: Pinkove zvezde
programme.desc: Jedno od najgledanijih i najvoljenijih muzičkih takmičenja na Balkanu - "Pinkove zvezde" - vraća se na velika vrata. Nova sezona počinje ove subote, 20. septembra u 21h na TV Pink, a publika može da očekuje uzbudljiviju, dinamičniju i emotivniju sezonu nego ikada do sada. Subotnje večeri ponovo će biti rezervisane za muziku koja pokreće, talente koje čeka uspeh i nastupe koji postaju viralni u roku od nekoliko sati. Gledaoci iz celog regiona imaće priliku da prate kako se pred njima rađaju nove zvezde - mladi umetnici koji svojim glasom, harizmom i upornošću žele da osvoje tron najprestižnijeg muzičkog takmičenja. U žiriju nas ove sezone očekuje nikad jača i šarenolikija postava, koja obećava pravu muzičku dinamiku, ali i mnogo zabave, suza, smeha i komentara koji će se dugo prepričavati: Jelena Karleuša - muzička diva i ikona stila, poznata po britkom jeziku i nemilosrdnoj iskrenosti; Zorica Brunclik - živa legenda narodne muzike, čije reči nose težinu, a iskustvo obuhvata decenije umetničkog rada; Dragan Stojković Bosanac - maestralni harmonikaš i muzički producent, koji zna kako da iz mladog pevača izvuče maksimum; Viki Miljković - popularna pevačica i mentor, prepoznatljiva po ljudskom pristupu, velikoj harizmi i dugogodišnjem iskustvu u radu s talentima i Desingerica - urbani fenomen i predstavnik nove muzičke generacije, koji će doneti svežinu, brzinu i direktan uvid u aktuelne muzičke tokove. Pet potpuno različitih pogleda, ukusa i kriterijuma, ali svi sa istim ciljem - da pronađu najveću novu muzičku zvezdu regiona.„Pinkove zvezde vodiće Ognjen Amidžić i Bojana Lazić. Njih dvoje će gledaoce voditi kroz svaku emisiju, pružajući ekskluzivne uvide, intervjue i emocije koje se ne mogu sakriti. Nova sezona donosi vizuelno i tehnički najmoćnije izdanje do sada - scenografija kakva se viđa samo u najvećim svetskim šou-programima, besprekoran zvuk, kao i pažljivo zabeležena svaka emocija na licima kandidata."Pinkove zvezde" nisu samo takmičenje - to je platforma koja je pokrenula karijere brojnih sadašnjih muzičkih zvezda. Ova emisija već godinama unazad pronalazi talentovane mlade ljude i pretvara ih u popularne izvođače koji pune hale, arene i trending liste.Ljubitelji dobre muzike, kvalitetnog zabavnog programa i iskrenih emocija - ne propustite premijernu epizodu nove sezone u subotu, 20. septembra u 21h. POČINJE SPEKTAKL! ZVEZDE SE RAĐAJU!

programme.title: PREMIJERA: vikend specijal
programme.desc: Za "Premijeru vikend specijal" govorile su najveće domaće i regionalne zvezde, a čine je i aktuelne vesti iz sveta šoubiznisa, kako domaćeg, tako i stranog. programme.title: Odbačena, serija
programme.desc: Reč je o životnoj avanturi devojčice po imenu Melisa Celik, koja je kao beba ostala bez roditelja, a koja je ostala u sirotištu. Niko ne zna istinu o tome šta se desilo njenoj porodici. Melisa pokušava da ostane sa porodicom koja ju je usvojila, ali Besime, domaćica, ne želi Melisu i podvrgava je raznim mučenjima. Jednog dana, kada je kao žrtvu gneva stave na vrata, pred njom se pojavljuje muškarac, Metin. Tada počinju da pričaju, nesvesni da će im se život od tog trenutka potpuno promeniti.

programme.title: Hit tvit
programme.desc: "Hit Tvit" je prema merenjima agencije "Nilsen" najgledaniji politički talk show u Srbiji, a od ostalih sličnih formata izdvaja ga interaktivnost televizije i korisnika društvenih mreža. Tvitovanjem i objavljivanjem statusa na Fejsbuku, korisnici imaju mogućnost da sa voditeljkom Vericom Bradić biraju priloge koji se emituju u emisiji. Upravo o tim prilozima, koji se uvek tiču aktuelnih političkih događaja iz zemlje i sveta, sa Vericom će u studiju diskutovati stručni gosti različitih političkih opredeljenja, što ovaj politički talk show čini dinamičnim.

programme.title: Ljubav i mržnja, serija
programme.desc: Serija prati zgode i nezgode bogate beogradske porodice Lazarević. Niko nije preboleo smrt majke, koja je bila stub porodice. Bogdanova nova supruga Kaća je moralno nepodobna. Temperamentna je i često stvara probleme unutar porodice. Takođe krije tajne iz prošlosti, koje je proganjaju. U biti je nesigurna ličnost i stidi se svojih seljačkih korena. Bogdanov sin Bojan je ženskaroš i ima aferu sa svojom maćehom Kaćom. To mu stvara niz neprilika, jer joj je obećao da će se razvesti od supruge i osnovati nov život sa njom. Međutim, Bojan ima niz ljubavnih veza. Njegova žena Ljubica je plemenita i odana osoba. Uspešna poslovna žena. Bojanov brat Miloš je novinar, nezadovoljan je, jer je zapravo želeo da bude pisac. Zbog toga često posegne za alkoholom. Njegova supruga Ivana očajnički želi da zatrudni, ali joj to ne uspeva. Njen otac Dušan je bivši narkoman i pravi joj dodatne probleme. Novinarka Zdenka je Miloševa koleginica iz lista "Jutarnja Zvezda", kojoj je porodica Lazarević omiljena tema. Bojanova i Miloševa sestra Olja je najmlađi član porodice i ona najviše pati zbog majčine smrti. Olja neočekivano zatrudni, otac deteta je njen profesor Vojin sa fakulteta. Nije sigurna šta da učini.

programme.title: Preživeti Beograd, serija
programme.desc: Preživeti Beograd je priča o mladim ljudima koji dolaze u Beograd da studiraju, njihovim željama, ljubavima, kao i ambicijama da uspeju u životu. Paralelno tu je i priča o njihovim roditeljima koji dolaze iz različitih socijalnih miljea. Zastupljeni su njihovi kontrasti, dolazak ljudi iz malih sredina u velikigrad. Preživeti Beograd je iskrena, dinamična serija koja se bavi optimizmom, ambicijama i emocijama, i samim tim mlađoj generaciji, ali i njihovim roditeljima nudi dobar sadržaj.

programme.title: Pinkove zvezde
programme.desc: Jedno od najgledanijih i najvoljenijih muzičkih takmičenja na Balkanu - "Pinkove zvezde" - vraća se na velika vrata. Nova sezona počinje ove subote, 20. septembra u 21h na TV Pink, a publika može da očekuje uzbudljiviju, dinamičniju i emotivniju sezonu nego ikada do sada. Subotnje večeri ponovo će biti rezervisane za muziku koja pokreće, talente koje čeka uspeh i nastupe koji postaju viralni u roku od nekoliko sati. Gledaoci iz celog regiona imaće priliku da prate kako se pred njima rađaju nove zvezde - mladi umetnici koji svojim glasom, harizmom i upornošću žele da osvoje tron najprestižnijeg muzičkog takmičenja. U žiriju nas ove sezone očekuje nikad jača i šarenolikija postava, koja obećava pravu muzičku dinamiku, ali i mnogo zabave, suza, smeha i komentara koji će se dugo prepričavati: Jelena Karleuša - muzička diva i ikona stila, poznata po britkom jeziku i nemilosrdnoj iskrenosti; Zorica Brunclik - živa legenda narodne muzike, čije reči nose težinu, a iskustvo obuhvata decenije umetničkog rada; Dragan Stojković Bosanac - maestralni harmonikaš i muzički producent, koji zna kako da iz mladog pevača izvuče maksimum; Viki Miljković - popularna pevačica i mentor, prepoznatljiva po ljudskom pristupu, velikoj harizmi i dugogodišnjem iskustvu u radu s talentima i Desingerica - urbani fenomen i predstavnik nove muzičke generacije, koji će doneti svežinu, brzinu i direktan uvid u aktuelne muzičke tokove. Pet potpuno različitih pogleda, ukusa i kriterijuma, ali svi sa istim ciljem - da pronađu najveću novu muzičku zvezdu regiona.„Pinkove zvezde vodiće Ognjen Amidžić i Bojana Lazić. Njih dvoje će gledaoce voditi kroz svaku emisiju, pružajući ekskluzivne uvide, intervjue i emocije koje se ne mogu sakriti. Nova sezona donosi vizuelno i tehnički najmoćnije izdanje do sada - scenografija kakva se viđa samo u najvećim svetskim šou-programima, besprekoran zvuk, kao i pažljivo zabeležena svaka emocija na licima kandidata."Pinkove zvezde" nisu samo takmičenje - to je platforma koja je pokrenula karijere brojnih sadašnjih muzičkih zvezda. Ova emisija već godinama unazad pronalazi talentovane mlade ljude i pretvara ih u popularne izvođače koji pune hale, arene i trending liste.Ljubitelji dobre muzike, kvalitetnog zabavnog programa i iskrenih emocija - ne propustite premijernu epizodu nove sezone u subotu, 20. septembra u 21h. programme.title: Moj najbolji prijatelj se ženi, film
programme.desc: Julianne Potter (J. Roberts) i Michael O'Neal (D. Mulroney) bliski su prijatelji. Iako su oboje mladi, zgodni i uspješni - ona je recenzentica restorana, a on sportski novinar - u ljubavi im baš ne ide. Devet godina ranije imali su kratku vezu nakon koje su ostali prijatelji. Tada su obećali jedno drugome da će se, ako do 28. godine ne sretnu ljubav svog života, vjenčati. I sve je u redu dok Michael ne kaže Julianne da se zaljubio u prekrasnu djevojku i da će se za četiri dana oženiti. K tome, moli Julianne da dođe u Chicago upoznati Kimberly (C. Diaz) i pomoći mu u najdelikatnijim ali i najsretnijim danima njegovog života. Julianne odjednom shvaća da voli Michaela i da ne može dopustiti da se oženi drugom djevojkom. Učinit će sve - makar i nemoralno i nedopušteno - da spriječi to vjenčanje. Ne ide joj na ruku to što Kimberly nije samo lijepa, privlačna i bogata, nego je draga i dobra osoba, dirljivo naivna i od prvog trenutka privržena najboljoj prijateljici svoga zaručnika. Uz Julianne je i njezin kolega George Downes (R. Everett), kojega Julianne predstavlja kao svog zaručnika ne bi li Michael bio ljubomoran... Ovu slavnu romantičnu komediju režirao je Australac P. J. Hogan, koji se proslavio komedijom "Muriel se udaje" (1994), nakon koje su mu bila otvorena vrata Hollywooda. Povjerenje je opravdao već ovim, svojim prvim američkim filmom, nakon kojega je režirao i hitove "Bezuvjetna ljubav", "Tajni snovi šopingholičarke" itd. Izvrsna glumačka ekipa osvojila je i publiku i kritiku. Najviše je nagrada osvojio R. Everett (nagradu američkih kritičara, nagradu londonskih kritičara, Satellite, Blockbuster Entertainment itd.), C. Diaz osvojila je nagradu ALMA, te Blockbuster Ent., kao i J. Roberts. R. Everett i J. Roberts nagrađeni su Zlatnim globusom. Film je bio u nominaciji za Oscara za originalnu glazbu (James Newton Howard), a osvojio je Zlatni globus kao najbolji film 1998. godine.

programme.desc: „Novo vikend jutro na Pinku u novoj televizijskoj sezoni vodi Jovana Jeremić. programme.title: Kafanica blizu SIS-a, serija
programme.desc: Već znamo da je "Agencija za sve i svašta" vlasotinačko preduzeće koje rešava sve probleme svojih klijenata. Osnivač i vlasnik firme je Spiridon Don Karamarković, nekadašnji pripadnik Legije stranaca, ekspert za sva pitanja i najškrtiji gazda na svetu. Deda mu je rekao da svaki uspešan Srbin mora da ima kafanu i on je ove godine osnovao svoju. Poslove oko kafane poverio je misterioznoj Madam Žaklini koja je naše gore list, ali je ugostiteljsko znanje sticala u Parizu.

programme.title: Hit tvit
programme.desc: "Hit Tvit" je prema merenjima agencije "Nilsen" najgledaniji politički talk show u Srbiji, a od ostalih sličnih formata izdvaja ga interaktivnost televizije i korisnika društvenih mreža. Tvitovanjem i objavljivanjem statusa na Fejsbuku, korisnici imaju mogućnost da sa voditeljkom Vericom Bradić biraju priloge koji se emituju u emisiji. Upravo o tim prilozima, koji se uvek tiču aktuelnih političkih događaja iz zemlje i sveta, sa Vericom će u studiju diskutovati stručni gosti različitih političkih opredeljenja, što ovaj politički talk show čini dinamičnim.

programme.title: Dečko koji obećava, film
programme.desc: Slobodan zvani Boba pristojan je dečko iz (malo)građanske beogradske obitelji, studira medicinu, svira gitaru i ima djevojku Mašu. Slobodanov je život isplaniran, budućnost osigurana. Jednoga dana upozna turistkinju Švicarku s kojom provede ugodno vrijeme. Saznavši za Slobodanovo druženje s nepoznatom, Maša u napadu ljubomore opali Slobodana veslom po glavi te on izgubi svijest. Nakon udarca u glavu Slobodan se mijenja. Odlazi od kuće, spava u studentskom domu i po stanicama, više nije pristojan mladić već provokativan buntovnik sklon izazivanju nereda. Prodaje svoj žuti golf i kupuje motor, odlazi na tulume gdje se upozna sa svojim budućim bandom...

programme.title: Nacionalna klasa, film
programme.desc: Humoristična drama o samoživom automobilistu koji se i pored neukrotive osobne prirode nađe zatočen u egzistencijalnom beznađu. Branimir Brane Mitrović zvani Floyd 27-godišnji je beogradski automobilist koji se uoči odlučujuće trke nalazi na trećem mjestu u ukupnom poretku u tzv. nacionalnoj klasi do 785 kubika, tj. u konkurenciji zastava 750, popularnih fića. Floyd je samoživ i neodgovoran zgubidan kojeg otac mesar stalno kritizira a majka tetoši, i koji uporno izbjegava poziv za služenje vojnog roka, tek formalno upisujući svake godine novi fakultet. Tako se sad odlučio na studij glume, gdje uoči prijemnog ispita upoznaje privlačnu Senku koju smjesta poželi, nimalo se ne obazirući na osjećaje svoje poluslužbene djevojke Vukosave zvane Šiljo. Međutim, Šiljo mu priopći da je ostala u drugom stanju, a njezini imućni roditelji, u dogovoru s Floydovim, ne pitajući ništa o tome Floyda i Šilju, pripreme svadbu... Nacionalna klasa do 785 ccm drugi je cjelovečernji igrani film Gorana Markovića, istaknutog pripadnika beogradskog ogranka tzv. praške škole kinematografije socijalističke Jugoslavije. Marković je debitirao dvije godine ranije Specijalnim vaspitanjem koje je smjesta steklo kultni status, dok je Nacionalna klasa bila manje kritički uvažena, ali prihvaćena od publike i rado gledana. Njezin središnji lik tipični je predstavnik karakterizacijskih stremljenja praške škole u tematiziranju suvremene urbane omladine (pa i šire): izdvojeni individualac koji se ne uklapa u društveno okruženje, međutim nepovratno je u njemu zarobljen što mu egzistenciju čini, bez obzira na njezinu eventualnu dinamičnost (kao u ovom slučaju), dubinski sumornom. Dragan Nikolić odličan je u ulozi u kakvima je nerijetko nastupao tijekom svoje karijere, dakle onoj anarhoidnog mladog čovjeka kao više ili manje dalekog izdanka Godardova Michela Poiccarda iz slavnog filma Do posljednjeg daha (tumačio ga je Jean-Paul Belmondo), s tim da ovdje njegov lik - za razliku od Godardova - ne skončava (apsurdistički intoniranom) nasilnom smrću kojom zapravo zadržava svoju slobodu, nego biva zarobljen nametnutim mu okovima malograđanskih životnih nazora. Sličan lik, lik Džimija Barke, tumačio je Nikolić i u klasiku Živojina Pavlovića Kad budem mrtav i beo, a Živojin Pavlović u Nacionalnoj klasi pojavljuje se u maloj cameo-roli. Spomenimo da naslovnu pjesmu filma pjeva Dado Topić, a da se među izvođačima pjesama uvrštenih u film nalaze i Oliver Dragojević, Slađana Milošević, Oliver Mandić i braća Vranešević.

programme.title: Devojka sa Kosmaja, film
programme.desc: Rat razdvaja dvoje zaljubljenih. Djevojka se opredjeljuje za partizane. Ratujući, ona traga za svojim mladićem i konačno saznaje da pripada suprotnoj strani. U jednoj akciji mladi partizan koji je u nju zaljubljen, da bi je zaštitio, bude ranjen i umire na njenim rukama. Djevojka sa Kosmaja, razapeta između dvije ljubavi, ne doživljava ni jednu.

programme.title: Nedjeljni ručak, film
programme.desc: Dušan Aranđelović je uspješni kirurg koji prolazi krizu srednjih godina i nezadovoljan je svojim životom. Rastrgan je između obitelji i ljubavnice, a profesionalni život ne pruža mu više ono zadovoljstvo koje je nekad imao, te počinje sve više piti. Kada mu se iznenada pruži mogućnost napredovanja na poslu, ali i na društvenoj ljestvici, pomisli da je to spasonosno rješenje, no ubrzo shvaća da je novi, bolji i drugačiji život za njega ipak samo san… Sjajnu glumačku ekipu okupio je redatelj Milan Jelić u ovoj drami, a predvodi ju Velimir Bata Živojinović uz kojega nastupaju Milena Dravić kao njegova supruga i Neda Arnerić u ulozi ljubavnice. Režija: Milan Jelić Uloge: Velimir Bata Živojinović, Milena Dravić, Neda Arnerić, Karlo Bulić

programme.title: Mala noćna muzika, film
programme.desc: Na mobitelski poziv pristojno je javiti se, a ako je pravi vlasnik mrtav, onda će to učiniti onaj tko ga čuje. Gordan Kičić i Vuk Kostić dva su zgubidana koje će vlastita bezbrižnost uvući u velegradski svijet iz kakvog bi najradije izašli. Hoće li im to poći za rukom? Spasoje (Vuk Kostić) i Cole (Gordan Kičić) simpatični su i pomalo blesavi mladići, koji rade u mrtvačnici. Jedne noći, začuju zvono mobitela iz džepa netom pridošlog mrtvaca te, naravno, ne mogu odoljeti a da ne odgovore na poziv. Na drugoj strani veze začuju glas tajanstvenog čovjeka koji ih uputi da odu na određenu adresu i podignu nekakav novac. Odbijanje lake zarade ne pada im na pamet, no sve skupa neće biti tako lako jer ih u navedenom stanu čeka starija gospođa koja ih želi seksualno iskoristiti, no po prvom pogledu na Spasojev spolni organ dobiva infarkt i na mjestu ostaje mrtva. Izlaz se čini sve manji i manji...'Mala noćna muzika' redatelja i scenarista Dejana Zečevića jedna je od najuvjerljivijih novijih srpskih komedija, priča o dvojici prijatelja koji se pokušavaju igrati u svijetu kriminala i porno industrije, sve više shvaćajući da to uopće nije igra. Uz scenarističku pomoć Biljane Maksić, Zečević je stvorio film s nepreglednim preokretima u radnji, pa Spasoje i Cole prelaze iz avanture u avanturu, ali 'Mala noćna muzika' ni u jednom trenu ne postaje kaotična i teška za pratiti. U iznimno komičnom i uzbudljivom okviru, autori ne prežu ni od suptilne kritike aktualnog stanja u državi u kojoj mladi ljudi ne dobivaju prave prilike, što sve skupa čini film boljim i uvjerljivijim.

programme.title: Igmanski marš, film
programme.desc: Krajem siječnja 1942. godine Prva proleterska brigada se na Romaniji našla opkoljena jakim njemačkim snagama. Štab brigade donosi odluku o izvršenju opasnog, ali jedino mogućeg pokreta. Trebalo je proći pored Sarajeva, preko Igmana, prema oslobođenoj Foči. Igmanski marš je izveden noću između 27. i 28. siječnja, po dubokom snijegu i velikoj hladnoći. Taj marš postaje legenda, a četrdeset teško promrzlih boraca prebačeno je na liječenje u Foču, gdje su junački podnijeli nadljudske bolove amputiranja promrzlih dijelova tijela bez narkoze.

Njezin središnji lik tipični je predstavnik karakterizacijskih stremljenja praške škole u tematiziranju suvremene urbane omladine (pa i šire): izdvojeni individualac koji se ne uklapa u društveno okruženje, međutim nepovratno je u njemu zarobljen što mu egzistenciju čini, bez obzira na njezinu eventualnu dinamičnost (kao u ovom slučaju), dubinski sumornom. Dragan Nikolić odličan je u ulozi u kakvima je nerijetko nastupao tijekom svoje karijere, dakle onoj anarhoidnog mladog čovjeka kao više ili manje dalekog izdanka Godardova Michela Poiccarda iz slavnog filma Do posljednjeg daha (tumačio ga je Jean-Paul Belmondo), s tim da ovdje njegov lik - za razliku od Godardova - ne skončava (apsurdistički intoniranom) nasilnom smrću kojom zapravo zadržava svoju slobodu, nego biva zarobljen nametnutim mu okovima malograđanskih životnih nazora. Sličan lik, lik Džimija Barke, tumačio je Nikolić i u klasiku Živojina Pavlovića Kad budem mrtav i beo, a Živojin Pavlović u Nacionalnoj klasi pojavljuje se u maloj cameo-roli. Spomenimo da naslovnu pjesmu filma pjeva Dado Topić, a da se među izvođačima pjesama uvrštenih u film nalaze i Oliver Dragojević, Slađana Milošević, Oliver Mandić i braća Vranešević.

programme.title: Nacionalna klasa, film
programme.desc: Humoristična drama o samoživom automobilistu koji se i pored neukrotive osobne prirode nađe zatočen u egzistencijalnom beznađu. Branimir Brane Mitrović zvani Floyd 27-godišnji je beogradski automobilist koji se uoči odlučujuće trke nalazi na trećem mjestu u ukupnom poretku u tzv. nacionalnoj klasi do 785 kubika, tj. u konkurenciji zastava 750, popularnih fića. Floyd je samoživ i neodgovoran zgubidan kojeg otac mesar stalno kritizira a majka tetoši, i koji uporno izbjegava poziv za služenje vojnog roka, tek formalno upisujući svake godine novi fakultet. Tako se sad odlučio na studij glume, gdje uoči prijemnog ispita upoznaje privlačnu Senku koju smjesta poželi, nimalo se ne obazirući na osjećaje svoje poluslužbene djevojke Vukosave zvane Šiljo. Međutim, Šiljo mu priopći da je ostala u drugom stanju, a njezini imućni roditelji, u dogovoru s Floydovim, ne pitajući ništa o tome Floyda i Šilju, pripreme svadbu... programme.title: Sok od šljiva, film
programme.desc: Miki Rudinski je popularni DJ provincijske radio stanice, čiji se način rada često ne poklapa sa ustaljenim normama. Za svoj "hepening u prirodi" uspeo je da zainteresuje i "Šljivo kombinat", najveću radnu organizaciju u mjestu. Na nesreću, datum održavanja njegovog "hepeninga" poklopio se sa danom proslave godišnjice osnivanja Kombinata, koji nije žalio truda ni novaca da to bude što svečanije. Zbog propagiranja svoje ideje preko radija Miki dolazi u sukob sa rukovodiocima koji ga suspenduju, a borba za publiku i izvođače vodi se svim sredstvima.

programme.title: Poker, film
programme.desc: Poker nije samo igra, to je filozofija! Što se događa kada se u njega miješa Borut, moderni anti junak bez poštovanja pravila? Duro je poslan da otkrije gdje nedostaje novac njegovog šefa, Matjaz je u igri da bude blizu svoje ljubavi, Aljosa se pokušava naći u pokeru. Vesna, "dealer", pokušava zadovoljiti sve, uključujući i sebe, u ovoj opasnoj igri ... Zato Borut postaje zapetljan u okrutnoj igri za život. U kriminalističkoj drami izokrenutoj i krvavoj podjeli, u kojoj će biti teško pronaći dobitnika. Poker govori istinu o životu, ne samo o smrti napisanoj u kartama.

programme.title: Branio sam Mladu Bosnu, film
programme.desc: Gavrilo Princip i drugovi, mladići koji snivaju o slobodi, izvršili su 28. lipnja 1914. atentat na prijestolonasljednika Austrougarske monarhije. Suočeni s ogromnim represijama Austrije, Princip i ostali su odlučili sve priznati. Međutim, bez obzira na sve pokušaje da se u istrazi nađu dokazi ona doživljava neuspjeh. Srbija nema nikakve veze s atentatom, ali ništa nije moglo zaustaviti rat...

programme.title: Jazzed Out Oslo, Urban
programme.desc: Jazzed Out proves that a jazz session can take place anywhere. Unusual locations, such as garage buildings, multi-storey car parks, street corners, subway trains, and parks, in several of the world’s metropoles, provide the setting for brief jazz performances. The sheer rawness of the metropoles merge with the musical creations of various artists in search of the perfect ‘urban stage’. In this episode, Oslo serves as a backdrop for sets by pianists Tord Gustavsen and Bugge Wesseltoft, as well as Jaga Jazzist collective.

programme.desc: Traditional

programme.title: Moondog & The London Saxophonique, Free
programme.desc: Moondog, a gaunt, mysterious and extravagantly-garbed blind street musician was celebrated among New Yorkers for two decades before gaining acclaim in Europe as an avant-garde composer conducting orchestras before royalty. Artists such as Charlie Parker, Leonard Bernstein, Steve Reich and Philip Glass have called him one of the great musical visionaries of our century. Day in and day out, the man whose real name is Louis T. Hardin, was as taciturn and unchanging a landmark of the midtown Manhattan streetscape as the George M. Cohan statue in Duffy Square. No matter the weather, he invariably dressed in a homemade robe, sandals, a flowing cape, and a horned Viking helmet - the tangible expression of what he referred to as his Nordic philosophy. For this show, he teams up with renowned saxophone ensemble London Saxophonic for an eccentric performance.

programme.title: Tamara Murphy - Spirograph Studies, Modern
programme.desc: Spirograph Studies have leapt onto the Australian music scene with their detailed, textural approach to playing improvised music. Post-rock, post-jazz and post-minimalism, they shamelessly steal sonic palettes from all areas to build their cinematic sound. This collaborative group features Luke Howard (piano), Fran Swinn (guitar) and James McLean (drums). This strong collection of music-makers each bring their unique voice to the stage as part a united front led by bassist Tamara Murphy.

programme.title: Come Twogether ft. Benjamin Herman, Jazz
programme.desc: Instead of children’s songs, the sound of jazz standards was always present. They practiced intricate drum rhythms instead of Bach etudes: Simon Oslender and Jérôme Cardynaals have jazz running through their veins! Under the name ‘Twogether’ both youngsters celebrate a very unique and soulful style of funky blues-jazz. They create a sound that leaves even renowned jazz artists speechless. The two, exceptionally talented boys met in a youth big band, and before long they became a musical team. Immediately after that, they won the first prize in the Prinses Christina Jazz Concours in Amsterdam, which got the whole thing started. In this concert, they perform with wonderful artists such as the Dutch saxophonist Benjamin Herman and the American vocalist Madeline Bell.

programme.title: Thomas Carbou: Spectacle Au Bleury, Fusion
programme.desc: Thomas Carbou and Patrick Graham share an almost telepathic rapport, blending spontaneous improvisation, electronic looping, and Brazilian and Indian musical influences to create ecstatic groove pieces and dream-like soundscapes. They use a wide array of instruments, including a custom-built 8-string guitar, cuatro, bouzouki, cajón, frame drums, berimbau, udu, and metal percussion instruments, as well as samplers and laptops, adding their own hypnotic vocals to the mix. This concert was recorded at Montréal’s Le Bleury Vinyl Bar, near the Place des Festivals, known worldwide as the venue for the Montreal International Jazz Festival.

programme.title: Teus Nobel live at the Bimhuis Amsterdam, Modern
programme.desc: Teus Nobel is a Dutch trumpet and flugelhorn player. As a little boy, he was inspired by ‘power’ trumpeters such as Maynard Ferguson and Bill Chase. While studying at the conservatory, he played both as jazz player and as a commercial session musician at musicals. After his time at the conservatory, he started playing in the Royal Netherlands Air Force Orchestra, playing march music influenced by pop and jazz. Today’s broadcast was recorded at the Amsterdam BIMhuis. Teus dedicates his compositions to his all-time heroes Jarmo Hoogendijk, Woody Shaw, Christian Scott, Roy Hargrove and Eric Vloeimans. This performance is based on his second album ‘Legacy’.

programme.title: Stift Festival: Suite del Ángel, Concert
programme.desc: Late August is traditionally the time for the annual Stift International Music Festival. Weerselo’s Stift Church and Oldenzaal’s ‘Hofkerk’ serve as venues for wonderful concerts of various young musicians from all over the world. The theme of the 2014 Stift Festival was Divine and Demonic Passion. Young musicians performed divine and demonic chamber music by composers such as Astor Piazzolla. Piazolla, who combined classical music and tango, created the ‘Nuevo Tango’ in the 1960s. In this period, he composed a number of tangos inspired on angels. These tangos had a spiritual touch. In the years before his death, Piazzolla used to perform this series of tangos as a single suite, the ‘Suite del Ángel’. This four-tango suite has been performed in several instrumentations. Brava broadcasts the version for bandoneon accompanied by the guitar, violin, double bass, and piano.

programme.title: Aretha Franklin: A trip in Paris, Soul
programme.desc: Live Recording at the Palais Des Sports from 1977. Aretha Franklin performs songs like ‘Respect’, ‘You make me feel like a natural woman’, ‘La vie en Rose’ and ‘Singing in the Rain’.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Boogieball, Urban
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.tv have been collaborating for a series of music programmes: ‘BIRD.tv’, allowing you to experience the best BIRD concerts and interviews as from the first row! This episode is a fantastic registration of the after party of the North Sea Jazz Festival: Boogieball. This mega jam session is a great coming together of, amongst others, bassist Bootsy Collins, guitarist Flávio Silva, and drummer/vocalist Sheila E.

programme.title: The Flying Pickets - Don't Turn Around, Jazz
programme.desc: The Flying Pickets are a British vocal group that was formed in 1982, transferring the art of a cappella to the pop music scene. These five gentlemen scored a number one hit in 1983 in the UK Singles Chart with their version of 'Only You'. Performing live in Stuttgart, vocalists Hereward Kaye, Gary Howard, Michael Henry, Nick Godfrey and Ricky Payne have many surprises in store for their appreciative audience.

programme.title: Mr Gentle and Mr Cool, Concert
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam. Among the many talents in the Orchestra were trumpeter Clark Terry, trombonist Quentin Jackson, saxophonist Johnny Hodges and violinist Ray Nance.

programme.title: Barbara, Concert
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums. During this performance from July 20, 1976, Silver’s quintet stretches out on four Silver originals: Adjustment, Barbara, In Pursuit of the 27th Man, and Song For My Father. Tune in and let Horace Silver’s irresistible music mesmerize you!

programme.title: Charles Lloyd Quartet live in Brussels
programme.desc: Traditional

programme.title: Paradox Live: Fay Claassen, Modern
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox. From young, local talents to top national and international artists, PARADOX Tilburg is the most intimate jazz club in the Netherlands, with a devoted audience from all across Europe. In their TV show PARADOX LIVE you get a taste of the greatest concerts and interviews with artists from all around the world. This episode of PARADOX LIVE presents the amazing Dutch jazz singer Fay Claassen

programme.title: Live at Paradiso, Amsterdam, Modern
programme.desc: Does a crisis stimulate creativity? When COVID-19 prevented the Robert Jay Band from performing for live audiences in 2021, the idea for ‘Paradiso Sessions’ sprang forth. Funk, rock, and soul guitarist, vocalist and songwriter Robert J. Reinders mused, if our audience will not come to see us, then we must go to see them. Hence the Robert Jay Band settled down in an atmospheric Paradiso in Amsterdam to perform for nine cameras. Among the twelve recorded songs is 1994’s monster hit ‘Red Bullet’. The remote audience gets to enjoy spirited musical contributions from Tollak Ollestad (vocals, keyboards, harmonica), Danjil Tuhumena (guitar, percussion, vocals), Roni Jonker (bass), Sietse Huisman (drums), and visiting band members Jasper Westerhof (keyboards), Dewi Pechler (backing vocals), and Merel van Eldik (backing vocals).

programme.title: PC Qwintett: 75th year of Courbois, Modern
programme.desc: Pierre Courbois has been one of Europe’s leading jazz musicians since the mid-sixties. This concert, recorded at the renowned Amsterdam jazz club Bimhuis, sees the drummer playing with his QWINTETT. On the occasion of his 75th birthday in 2015, Courbois hit the road for the Pierre Courbois 75 Years Anniversary Tour. The PC QWINTETT consists of several highly acclaimed Dutch jazz musicians with whom Courbois has worked before in his long and versatile career. Among them are pianist Nike Langenhuijsen, double bassist Egon Kracht, trumpeter Toon de Gouw, and trombonist Ilja Reijngoud. QWINTETT honours the Charles Mingus tradition of thematic and melodic ensemble jazz - but also with an unmistakable Courbois groove! Courbois, known for his own way of combining compositions with improvisations, melodically melts constructions with uneven breaks.

programme.title: Troy 'Trombone Shorty' Andrews: Jazz à Vienne, Jazz
programme.desc: Jazz phenomenon Trombone Shorty dishes out a mix of funk, jazz, hip-hop and soul at this concert at the French festival Jazz à Vienne. Playing with the energy of a rock star, Troy Andrews, a.k.a. ‘Trombone Shorty’, pays homage to jazz legends. With his hypnotic performance and boundless energy, Trombone Shorty puts up an unparalleled performance.

programme.title: Vamos fugir, Concert
programme.desc: Brazilian artist Gilberto Gil returns to Jazz à Vienne in France with a new round of singing that is inspired by his latest album ‘Fé na Festa’: a mixture of celebration, tradition and even some rock now and then. Gilberto Gil, worldwide known for as musician and the Brazilian minister of Culture, was one of the pioneers of the cultural movement ‘tropicalismo’. This movement, with a strong character of social protest, combines elements of traditional Brazilian culture with modern art forms. Gilberto Gil's new sound clearly has its roots in Brazilian culture, yet it is always inspired by jazz.

programme.title: Jon Hendricks and Co: Estival 1986, Blues
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. John Carl Hendricks is one of the instigators of "vocalese", an art form that aims to add lyrics to existing instrumental pieces and replace several instruments with singing. He flaunts this technique at Estival, where he "scat" while playing double bass. Hendricks is known for his mastery of scat, a form of vocal jazz that uses onomatopoeia rather than lyrics

programme.title: Fats Domino - The North Sea Jazz, Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. American singer and pianist Fats Domino gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival of 1980. Domino was one of the pioneers of rock and roll music, selling more than 65 million records and having 11 top hits between 1955 and 1960.

programme.title: BIRD - The Nest, Modern
programme.desc: Five promising musicians get together in Rotterdam jazz club BIRD’s artists-in-residence project The Nest. Over the course of seven sessions, these talents exchange ideas, work on their projects, and play music together. Following this period, during which record producer Jameszoo and music manager Jochem Tromp offer their coaching experience, BIRD and North Sea Jazz Festival’s fringe festival DownTown organize a tryout performance. In this short documentary, the artists share their impressions from the project. They introduce themselves, reveal why they joined The Nest and formulate what they hope to learn from the experience. Naturally, we get a glimpse of the songs they wrote during the sessions, as performed during the tryout show. Featuring Lisette Ma Neza (slam poet), Peter Somuah (trumpet), Michelle Samba (drums), Huy Le (bass), and Brenn Luiten (piano).

programme.title: Portrait of Maria Ana Bobone, Concert
programme.desc: Maria Ana Bobone (Portugal) is one of the best fado singers of her generation. She started singing fado when she was 16. Her debut album is called ‘Alma Nova’ and marked the beginning of her amazing career. For the recordings of her next two albums, ‘Luz Destino’ and ‘Senhora da Lapa’ Maria Ana welcomed instruments that are usually not present in fado music: the harpsichord and saxophone. After that, she continued her career with the release of ‘Nome de Mar’, which received many positive reviews. At the moment, Maria Ana is performing at all Portugal’s major venues, as well as many festivals and concert halls throughout the world, with the aim to present fado music and Portuguese culture to other cultures. Bobone’s latest album, ‘Fado & Piano’, shows her diversity as an artist, composer and arranger. By including the piano she re-innovates the tradition of the early 20th century. This portrait shows Maria Ana’s performances and interviews in which she explains her passion for fado music and culture.

programme.title: Aki Rissanen Trio at Jazzclub Unterfahrt, Munich, Modern
programme.desc: Aki Rissanen's interest in jazz came after he started taking classical piano lessons. His deep interest in improvised music placed him among top jazz pianist in his home country - Finland. While composing and performing his own music, Rissanen has also collaborated with Verneri Pohjola and Dave Liebman, and today his name appears among the top European jazz musicians. Live from 'Jazzclub Unterfahrt' in Munich, Germany, together with Antti Lotjonen on bass and Teppo Makynen on drums, Rissanen showcases the best of Scandinavian jazz and its DNA - the Nordic Tone.

programme.title: In Good Shape - Voice and speech disorders

Iako se na kulturna zbivanja u Hrvatskoj ne ulaže kao prije sveopće gospodarske krize, možemo ustvrditi da je kuturni život, na svim platformama, upravo onaj čimbenik koji drži visoko uzdignutu glavu i uspješno uništava društvenu letargiju i životnu bezvoljnost uzrokovanu višegodišnjim krizom.

programme.title: Vrijeme je za Timmyja
programme.desc: Timmy je malo janje željno novih znanja. Upravo je navršio tri godine, a budući da je jedino janje u stadu, navikao je da sve bude po njegovom. No sad kreće u vrtić s drugim mladuncima i morat će se naučiti ponašati u društvu svojih vršnjaka. U svakoj se epizodi prikazuje jedan dan u vrtiću. Svakodnevnu rutinu remete jedino ludorije mališana. Kroz razne zgode i nezgode, Timmy i njegovi prijatelji uče o životu i prijateljstvu.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit.

programme.title: Volim klasiku, 44. izdanje
programme.desc: U novom izdanju emisije Volim klasiku popularna dela klasične muzike izvodi orkestar Kamerata Serbika sa solistima: violinistkinjom Milicom Zulus, flautistom LJubišom Jovanovićem i instrumentalistom na harmonici Bobanom Bjelićem. programme.title: TV prozor: Šotra, od početka... i dalje
programme.desc: Zdravko Šotra, reditelj i scenarista, rođen je 14. februara 1933. u Stocu. Diplomirao je režiju na Akademiji za pozorište, film, radio i televiziju u Beogradu 1954. u klasi profesora Vjekoslava Afrića. Na Televiziji Beograd bio je zaposlen od njenog osnivanja1958. do 2001. Potpisao je preko 120 televizijskih i filmskih ostvarenja velike gledanosti kako na televiziji, tako i u bioskopima.

Dobrica Ćosić požuruje Tita da pošalje Andriću telegram kojim će mu čestitati. Na konferenciji za novinare, Andrić odgovara na pitanja o Bosni i detinjstvu, čime priziva sećanje na boravak u Sarajevu 1945, odlazak na majčin grob, skupštinu ZAVNOBIH-a i susrete sa Elijem Fincijem i školskim drugom Borom Jevtićem.

Zagorci, Međimurci, Podravci, ali i ostali kojima je KAJ u duši u svakoj će od emisija pronaći nešto za sebe - glazba poznatih pjevača i sastava kajkavskog kraja, zanimljive priče i legende, ali i posebnosti koje svojim sadržajem odražavaju duhovitost, vrijednost tradicije te bogatu i znimljivu povijest i puno dobre zabave.

programme.title: VTV TJEDNIK, informativna emisija
programme.desc: donosi pregled najvažnijih događaja u Gradu Varaždinu, Varaždinskoj i Međimurskoj županiji koji su obilježili protekli tjedan. Sve te događaje prikazujemo ponovno, ovoga puta u novom svjetlu, promatrajući ih s vremenske distance, uz najnovije informacije i komentare. Pregled je realiziran tako da se po danima (od ponedjeljka do subote) ponove opširne vijesti koje su obilježile pojedine dane. Emisiju «VTV tjednik» realiziramo s komentarom za slušno oštećene osobe, čime smo uspjeli, na veliko zadovoljstvo, približiti naš informativni program i toj skupini naših gledatelja.

programme.title: PUTOPISI, dokumentarna emisija
programme.desc: Jurica Galić Juka profesionalni je fotograf, svjetski putnik, putopisac, stalni suradnik časopisa Meridijani i snimatelj dokumentarnih filmova iz Splita. Do 2022. godine obišao je više od 70 država na 5 kontinenata, piše putopise i izrađuje video dokumentarce. U fotografiji je dobitnik dvadesetak nacionalnih i svjetskih nagrada, a izlagao je samostalno trinaest puta.

programme.title: KULTURNI MAGAZIN, umjetnost i kultura

"Kulturni magazin" svojim reportažama i razgovorima s umjetnicima uspješno prati kulturne teme i fenomene, posjećuje zabavne manifestacije i prati sva važna zbivanja u regiji.

programme.title: Zarobljena, serija
programme.desc: 684. epizoda - Gurbuz pokušava utješiti Edže nakon što ona shvati da je Aziz sve vrijeme bio policajac i da su njihove zaruke bile prevara. Gđa Behije saznaje od Elif da je Aziz ranjen. Ona odlazi u bolnicu da posjeti svog sina, gdje joj Elif otkriva da je on ostao policajac i da je bio na tajnom zadatku. Ejlul iskopava zemlju na mjestu gdje je sahranila Juksela da bi uzela mobitel iz njegovog džepa. U povratku se pokušava smiriti, ali nailazi na gđu Afife kojoj ponovo postaje sumnjiva.

programme.title: Anatomija života
programme.desc: Nova emisija u programu Hayat TV-a je Anatomija života. Cilj ove emisije jeste da u saradnji sa stručnim osobljem, ljekarima i profesorima gledateljima ponudimo odgovore na mnogobrojna pitanja o zdravlju. Okruženi i „zatrpani različitim zdravstvenim savjetnicima koji se kroz različite platforme nameću bez sigurnih izvora, odlučili smo postaviti emisiju u kojoj će profesionalne i etablirane ličnosti odgovoriti na pitanja o prevenciji zdravlja. Mnogi su simptomi koji upućuju na određene tegobe te mogu biti kobni za život pojedinca. Pomoći ćemo i učiniti sve da pravovremeno svakom gledatelju pružimo zdravstveni savjet. Zdravlje, kao jedna od najvažnijih tema, vodi nas do mnogobrojnih svakodnevnih pitanja koja ćemo pravovremeno komunicirati, a u korist gledatelja i njihovih pitanja. Bit će ovo TV ordinacija u kojoj svi imaju priliku sudjelovati. Naši gosti su ljekari, stručnjaci s dugogodišnjim iskustvom. Briga o zdravlju je i najvažnija tema koja umnogome kreira zadovoljno društvo. Medijski komunicirati i proširiti profesionalne teze kao odgovor na mnogobrojna pitanja o zdravlju naš je zadatak.

programme.title: Za istim stolom
programme.desc: Jedinstveni recepti najboljih kuhara koji nam omogućavaju da manje vremena provedemo u kuhinji, a više u razgovoru za stolom. Za stolom ne dijelimo samo hranu, dijelimo vrijeme, pažnju, ljubav i za istim stolom postajemo bolji. U emisiji 'Za istim stolom' razgovaramo o nečemu što svi poznajemo, ali rijetko o tome duboko razmišljamo - o filozofiji okupljanja za stolom. Da li je ručak samo obrok ili mnogo više? Cilj ove emisije je da ugostimo plemenite goste, podijelimo s njima stil života kao važne lekcije, razgovaramo o vrijednostima života, ali i kvaliteti obroka. Naša opredjeljenost je uvijek za najbolje i to dijelimo i sa gledateljima. Pred nama je sezona izdvojenih tema, posebnih recepata, specijalnih gostiju kroz koju nas vodi Maja Munda.

programme.title: Mjesto povratka - Život povratnika
programme.desc: „Mjesto povratka se u novoj sezoni fokusira na ljude koji su se unatoč teškim okolnostima odlučili na potez povratka, koji je okarakterisan kao „svjetski fenomen. U ovoj sezoni „Moja povratnička priča biće vodilja emisije kroz direktniji pristup povratnicima i detaljima njihovog povratka.

programme.title: Grad i...
programme.desc: Ponekad je grad boja u kojoj se otkrivaju razne ljepote, a ponekad glas koji otkriva dublja značenja. Grad je ispunjen svjetlosti koja daje olakšanje srcima. To je umjetnost i hrana za čovjekovu dušu. U njemu se zrcale kultura, književnost, trgovina, gastronomija, arhitektura, historija i ljudi. Grad i… je dokumentarni program koji govori o tragovima čovjeka u gradovima.

programme.title: Vjetrovi ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: 108. epizoda - Songul likuje zbog skorog izbacivanja Aslanlija iz vile, a posebno je raduje razdvajanje Halila od Zejnep. Također je sretna što se neće saznati prava istina o Halilovim roditeljima, koje je sama Songul uništila. Halil i Zejnep kreče Zumrutinu sobu, a Zejnep insistira da joj objasni zašto ih istjeruje. Jusuf je u potrazi za Guldže i pronalazi je uplakanu na groblju. Songul je preplašena zbog Halilove ideje da otkrije istinu Zejnep i njenoj porodici.

programme.title: Vjetrovi ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: 109. epizoda - Zumrut naziva Songul zmijom željnom osvete. Zejnep traži od Halila da joj objasni o kakvoj je osveti riječ. Songul je prestrašena da bi istina mogla izaći na vidjelo. Aslanliji se pitaju ko je mogao platiti Mervinu školarinu. Na groblju, Guldže pada u nesvijest i Jusuf je odnosi kući. Feriha donosi iftar Hakanu i ostaje da iftare zajedno. Hakan joj daje poslovnu ideju. Zejnep prihvata odlazak s imanja, ali kaže Halilu da joj prvo mora reći razlog zašto ih izbacuje.

programme.title: Vjetrovi ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: 110. epizoda - Tulaj hvali Selmu zbog svih nedaća koje je stoički podnijela. Eren je sretan jer mu Selma odgovara na poruke. Zumrut ima noćnu moru, a u pomoć joj dolaze Zejnep i Halil. Halila grize savjest zbog toga što izbacuje Aslanlije s imanja, ali s druge strane su Gulhan i Songul. Majstor Aziz dolazi da vidi Halila, a Zumrut traži da se Halil i Zejnep što prije zaruče. Guldže i Jusuf misle jedno o drugome, ali nikako da otvoreno priznaju svoja osjećanja.

programme.title: Vjetrovi ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: 111. epizoda - U prisustvu majstora Aziza pada dogovor da se navečer organizuju lažne zaruke Halila i Zejnep, kako bi se ispunila Zumrutina želja. Zumrut također želi da Zejnep nosi haljinu s njenih zaruka. Zejnep traži od Halila da joj otkrije zašto mrzi njenu porodicu. Šehnaz i Nevin saznaju da Jusuf radi noću kao nosač. Da bi pomogla da se otplati dug, Nevin odlučuje prodati komad zemlje u svom selu. Feriha ne može naći novi posao, a Hakan je tješi. U vili traju pripreme za zaruke...

programme.title: Vjetrovi ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: 112. epizoda - Hakan se bori da osvoji Ferihino srce i predlaže joj da počnu da rade zajedno. Guldže odlučuje da Jusufa oslobodi od stega lažnog braka. Eren pregleda Selmine slike na internetu i osmijeh mu ne silazi s lica. U vili se održava ceremonija zaruka, a Halil poredi Zejnepinu ljepotu s mjesečinom. Zumrut traži od Songul da ona, kao glava kuće, isprosi Zejnep za Halila. Sve se okončava stavljanjem prstenja, Halilovim poljupcem i velikom radošću Zumrut. Istovremeno, Songul se kune da će spriječiti Zejnepinu sreću.

programme.title: Kome dobro pjevaš
programme.desc: Muzička emisija „Kome dobro pjevaš je originalni i potpuno novi format Hayat televizije, koja za cilj ima pružiti prostor svima onima koji uživaju u muzici i žele da svoj glas podijele s publikom. Za razliku od klasičnih takmičenja, ovdje fokus nije na strogoj konkurenciji, već na zajedničkom uživanju u muzici i na prilici da se svako predstavi na svoj način. Za sve koji pjevaju kod kuće, u društvu, uz gitaru s prijateljima ili jednostavno vole da zapjevaju kad god osjete ritam, naš studio je pravi prostor, a gledatelji imaju priliku uživati u iskrenim interpretacijama, spontanosti i druženju kroz pjesmu.

Svakodnevno pravimo naše priče po kojima smo postali prepoznatljiv brend i prvi izbor gledalaca dugi niz godina. Naš izbor je istina, neka vaš budu Vijesti u 7.

programme.title: Ispuni mi želju
programme.desc: Emisija Ispuni mi želju, koja usrećuje porodice, djecu, stare i mlade program je za sve generacije. Otvaranje puteva sreće, ličnog zadovoljstva jer smo nekoga učinili sretnim barem na trenutak, osjećaj je koji se ne može mijenjati nijednim drugim. Spoznaja da smo svi zajedno bili dio promjene, otvorili jedan novi prozor u nedodirljivo je apsolutna sloboda, a načini na koji usrećujemo druge su bezbrojni, neograničeni i snažno u konačnici umirujući. Društveno odgovorna osoba, koja predvodi društveno odgovorno poslovanje i čini život ugodnijim ljudima oko sebe sigurno je kvalitetan proizvod zajednice koja ga okružuje. Biti uvijek na strani one ruke koja nas treba je jednostavnost života kojoj svi težimo, a upravo ta savršena jednostvanost čovjeka ispunjava do beskraja, i još dalje. Imati priliku biti na putu dobra, i mogućnosti da se promovirate kroz nemjerljive trenutke radosti jednog života privilegija je onih koji će uvijek i u svemu vidjeti, a na kraju i osjetiti samo uspjeh i zadovoljstvo, kako poslovno tako i lično.

programme.title: Slučajevi X
programme.desc: Emisija Slučajevi X, koja se nedjeljom u 22 sata emitira u programu Hayat TV-a, jedna je od najgledanijih u BiH, a prepoznatljiva je i van granica naše domovine. Ova specijalistička emisija tretira tamnu stranu života u Bosni i Hercegovini i regionu. Tamo gdje policija ide s upaljenim rotacijama, Slučajevi X dolaze s kamerom. Slučajevi X su specifičan format TV-emisije i prvi kriminalistički magazin u našoj zemlji. Od prve emisije skreće veliku pažnju gledalaca gotovo svakom novom epizodom. I to traje već godinama, od 2007, što potvrđuje gledanost emisije, ali i milionski pregledi na Youtubeu. Primarni cilj emisije jeste da u mladima ne podstiče želju da idu stranputicom, odnosno putem kriminala, da shvate da kriminal nije model ponašanja koji je društveno prihvatljiv. Vremenom, zbog društvenog doprinosa, Slučajevi X su postali višestruko nagrađivana emisija. Gotovo da nema policijske agencije ili uprave u BiH koja, zbog navedenog, nije Slučajevima X javno dodijelila specijalna priznanja i zahvalnice.

programme.title: Barbarosa, serija

programme.desc: Uz biranu glazbu i pogled na najljepšu ulicu na svijetu (Stradun), gledatelji mogu promatrati Grad i s njegove najviše kote - tvrđave Imperijal na Srđu. programme.title: MIRELICA PRIČALICA, dječja emisija (S3)
programme.desc: Dječju emisiju Mirelica Pričalica emitiramo svakodnevno. U društvu s djevojčicama, dječacima, a ponekad i njihovim kućnim ljubimcima, Mirela Zijadić čita bajke ili poučne dječje priče domaćih i inozemnih autora. Njezini maleni gosti slušaju i komentiraju pročitano te daju svoje viđenje ili poantu sadržaja. Priče su prilagođene uzrastu djece koja ponekad sama odabiru djela koja žele slušati. Djecu koja gledaju emisiju trudimo se potaknuti na čitanje i razumijevanje pročitanog.
